text:
The amendment is likely constitutional as applied. It is neutral and generally applicable under *Employment Division v. Smith*: it denies the benefit for refusing prescribed care for any reason, religious or secular, except objectively excessive risk, so strict scrutiny likely does not apply. The "conditions a benefit" rationale in the team note is weaker than the neutrality and general-applicability point, which is the basis for this answer.

CONFIDENCE: 75
